summary: PD-16 FIX: the confined SEARCH native tool module (`src/plugin/live/confined-search-tool.mjs`) is plain JS loaded through the route-C seam by the byte-copied realm row (`a5sf-realm-row.mjs`, placement 120). It registers the model-visible `grep`/`glob` by delegating to the pinned host package's PUBLIC per-tool faces (`applyGrepTool`/`applyGlobTool`), so tsc never emits it and it rides the dist mirror at its repo-relative layout; the realm row resolves it with `new URL('./confined-search-tool.mjs', import.meta.url)`, so without this entry the installed face would fail at member setup with ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND — not at build time.
